index d7d9bd04..bab3f5b1 100644
--- a/src/jinja2/loaders.py
+++ b/src/jinja2/loaders.py
@@ -71,6 +71,60 @@ class BaseLoader:
     #: .. versionadded:: 2.4
     has_source_access = True
 
+    @property
+    def aliases(self) -> t.Dict[str, str]:
+        """Mapping of alias names to the template names they point to.
+        Created lazily because subclasses are not required to call
+        ``BaseLoader.__init__``.
+
+        .. versionadded:: 3.1
+        """
+        try:
+            return self.__dict__["_aliases"]  # type: ignore[no-any-return]
+        except KeyError:
+            aliases: t.Dict[str, str] = {}
+            self.__dict__["_aliases"] = aliases
+            return aliases
+
+    def add_alias(self, alias: str, target: str) -> None:
+        """Make the template ``target`` available under the name
+        ``alias`` as well. Adding an existing alias replaces it. Aliases
+        are not resolved recursively.
+
+        .. versionadded:: 3.1
+        """
+        self.aliases[alias] = target
+
+    def remove_alias(self, alias: str) -> None:
+        """Remove an alias added with :meth:`add_alias`. Removing an
+        alias that does not exist is not an error.
+
+        .. versionadded:: 3.1
+        """
+        self.aliases.pop(alias, None)
+
+    def resolve_alias(self, name: str) -> str:
+        """Return the template name ``name`` points to if it is an
+        alias, otherwise return ``name`` unchanged. Only one level of
+        aliasing is resolved.
+
+        .. versionadded:: 3.1
+        """
+        return self.aliases.get(name, name)
+
+    def transform_path(self, template: str) -> str:
+        """Apply the loader's ``path_transform`` function, if any, to
+        ``template`` and return the path used for the actual lookup.
+
+        .. versionadded:: 3.1
+        """
+        path_transform = getattr(self, "path_transform", None)
+
+        if path_transform is None:
+            return template
+
+        return path_transform(template)  # type: ignore[no-any-return]
+
     def get_source(
         self, environment: "Environment", template: str
     ) -> t.Tuple[str, t.Optional[str], t.Optional[t.Callable[[], bool]]]:
@@ -95,7 +149,7 @@ class BaseLoader:
             raise RuntimeError(
                 f"{type(self).__name__} cannot provide access to the source"
             )
-        raise TemplateNotFound(template)
+        raise TemplateNotFound(self.resolve_alias(template))
 
     def list_templates(self) -> t.List[str]:
         """Iterates over all templates.  If the loader does not support that
@@ -170,6 +224,8 @@ class FileSystemLoader(BaseLoader):
     :param encoding: Use this encoding to read the text from template
         files.
     :param followlinks: Follow symbolic links in the path.
+    :param path_transform: Optional function that receives the
+        template name and returns the path used to look it up.
 
     .. versionchanged:: 2.8
         Added the ``followlinks`` parameter.
@@ -180,6 +236,7 @@ class FileSystemLoader(BaseLoader):
         searchpath: t.Union[str, os.PathLike, t.Sequence[t.Union[str, os.PathLike]]],
         encoding: str = "utf-8",
         followlinks: bool = False,
+        path_transform: t.Optional[t.Callable[[str], str]] = None,
     ) -> None:
         if not isinstance(searchpath, abc.Iterable) or isinstance(searchpath, str):
             searchpath = [searchpath]
@@ -187,11 +244,13 @@ class FileSystemLoader(BaseLoader):
         self.searchpath = [os.fspath(p) for p in searchpath]
         self.encoding = encoding
         self.followlinks = followlinks
+        self.path_transform = path_transform
 
     def get_source(
         self, environment: "Environment", template: str
     ) -> t.Tuple[str, str, t.Callable[[], bool]]:
-        pieces = split_template_path(template)
+        template = self.resolve_alias(template)
+        pieces = split_template_path(self.transform_path(template))
         for searchpath in self.searchpath:
             filename = os.path.join(searchpath, *pieces)
             f = open_if_exists(filename)
@@ -239,6 +298,8 @@ class PackageLoader(BaseLoader):
     :param package_path: Directory within the imported package that
         contains the templates.
     :param encoding: Encoding of template files.
+    :param path_transform: Optional function that receives the
+        template name and returns the path used to look it up.
 
     The following example looks up templates in the ``pages`` directory
     within the ``project.ui`` package.
@@ -269,6 +330,7 @@ class PackageLoader(BaseLoader):
         package_name: str,
         package_path: "str" = "templates",
         encoding: str = "utf-8",
+        path_transform: t.Optional[t.Callable[[str], str]] = None,
     ) -> None:
         package_path = os.path.normpath(package_path).rstrip(os.path.sep)
 
@@ -281,6 +343,7 @@ class PackageLoader(BaseLoader):
         self.pack
